scope: Targeted primary-source reading for the researcher-requested 2026-10-04 closeout; not exhaustive; not an execution contract.
method: Read primary text at listed sections; distinguish source claims, assumptions and AI project-specific interpretation.

sources.title: The Benefit of Multitask Representation Learning
sources.boundary: Task-dependent shared-representation bounds; not SGD or retention guarantees

sources.title: On the Theory of Transfer Learning: The Importance of Task Diversity
sources.read_scope: Sections 2 and 3; assumptions and task-diversity definitions
sources.boundary: Common covariate distribution, realizability, regularity and task coverage matter

sources.title: Which Tasks Should Be Learned Together in Multi-task Learning?
sources.read_scope: Experimental setup, capacity/data comparisons and grouping
sources.boundary: Supervised task combinations and resource-sensitive affinity

sources.title: Efficiently Identifying Task Groupings for Multi-Task Learning
sources.read_scope: Sections 4, 4.3 and 6; shared update, counterexamples and changing affinity
sources.boundary: Local lookahead and retrained-group performance remain separate

sources.title: Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning
sources.read_scope: Method and theory, first four pages
sources.boundary: Conflict, domination and curvature; per-task gradients cost work

sources.title: AdaShare: Learning What To Share For Efficient Deep Multi-Task Learning
sources.boundary: Known-task block execution policy, regularization and training curriculum

sources.title: Overcoming catastrophic forgetting in neural networks
sources.read_scope: Methods and empirical limitations of Fisher approximation
sources.boundary: Soft diagonal-Fisher protection; not frozen functions

sources.title: Progressive Neural Networks
sources.boundary: Frozen old columns; task selection and growing storage

sources.title: PackNet: Adding Multiple Tasks to a Single Network by Iterative Pruning
sources.read_scope: Section 3 including biases and batch-normalization state
sources.boundary: Task masks, prune/retrain cost, finite free capacity; no automatic hardware speed claim

sources.title: DeepSeekMoE: Towards Ultimate Expert Specialization in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
sources.boundary: Matched-budget shared-expert ablation; branch importance does not identify universal semantics

sources.title: OLMoE: Open Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
sources.boundary: Opposite shared-expert ablation under a different setup; routing-freedom explanation is a hypothesis

sources.title: OpenMoE: An Early Effort on Open Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
sources.boundary: Token-dependent early routing in studied models only

sources.title: FlexOlmo: Open Language Models for Flexible Data Use
sources.boundary: Frozen public/shared parameters, external domain embedder and optional router tuning

sources.title: When Are Experts Misrouted? Counterfactual Routing Analysis in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
sources.boundary: Post-hoc target CE; bounded last-layer router-only existence check, extra counterfactual training cost

sources.title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
sources.read_scope: Sections 2.1-2.4; gate derivatives, capacity, objective and precision
sources.boundary: Task gradient through retained gate amplitude; T5-style denoising, not a direct causal NTP result

sources.title: Mixture-of-Experts with Expert Choice Routing
sources.boundary: Batch-coupled expert capacity and variable token compute; future-token access explicitly limits direct autoregressive use

sources.title: On the Representation Collapse of Sparse Mixture of Experts
sources.read_scope: Sections 2-4.5; Jacobian decomposition, learned projection and component ablations
sources.boundary: Existing project precedent reread; low-rank gate component alone is not a universal full-state collapse theorem; MLM differs from NTP
